column1: The positive results of the LISA-1 trial, of which ROVI has already informed the market, showed that the first
development of letrozole (annual Letrozole ISM®) allows an oestrogen suppression higher than that of Femara® to be
predicted (with an initial dose of 100 mg plus a further 100 mg after 8 weeks, and annual maintenance doses of 100 mg,
compared with daily oral doses of 2.5 mg), maintaining plasma levels of letrozole significantly lower than those reached
with daily oral doses of 2.5 mg of Femara®, taking account of the fact that the inhibition of the enzyme aromatase and,
therefore, a reduction in oestrogen synthesis is the only known pharmacological mechanism of letrozole
